messages:
Arjun: Noticing ~+8% token delta between invoice-preview and final tallies for a handful of mid-size tenants after yesterday's preview-writer deploy. Affected window ~2026-03-21 22:00-23:30 UTC.
Mei: Any recent changes to tokenization? we shipped the new tokenizer library yesterday, right?
Arjun: Yep. preview-writer bumped tokenizer from `tiktoken v0.6.3` -> `tokenize-plus v1.0.0` (claim: faster & unicode-aware).
Priya: Could be tokenization semantics diff (eg. unicode combining chars, emojis). If preview used new tokenizer but tally pipeline uses old one, token counts diverge.
Julian: Can we get a quick diff on per-request token counts? SQL on samples: ```SELECT p.request_id, p.tokens AS preview_tokens, t.tokens AS tally_tokens, p.input_text FROM previews p JOIN tallies t USING (request_id) WHERE p.hour BETWEEN '2026-03-21 22:00' AND '2026-03-21 23:30' LIMIT 50;```
Dan: ran that on a small shard. ~45% of rows show preview_tokens > tally_tokens, median delta ~ +6 tokens per request, skewed on emoji/heavy-unicode inputs.
Mei: that matches what the tokenizer change would do (we switched to NFC normalization + grapheme-aware splits). Old tokenizer counted base+combining as 2 tokens more often. New one merges so counts can go down or up depending on edge cases.
Arjun: For the tenants we saw net increase, so new tokenizer produced more tokens on average for their traffic patterns (lots of pasted text with zero-width joiners).
Priya: So root cause: tokenizer schema mismatch between preview-writer (v1.0.0) and tally-ingest (still on v0.6.3).
Julian: Options: 1) revert preview-writer to old tokenizer (fast rollback), 2) roll tally-ingest forward to new tokenizer (longer but aligned), 3) mark previews as "tokenization-unstable" and pause preview-sends for affected window.
Dan: Reverting preview is fastest to stop new deltas from being shown to customers. But we also need to decide what we consider canonical: tally or new tokenizer? We should standardize on canonical tokenizer in billing pipeline.
Mei: We intentionally planned to standardize on tokenize-plus in Q2 once we backfilled and validated. This rollout was premature for preview-writer only.
Arjun: Immediate action: flip preview-writer back to tiktoken v0.6.3 and add console banner: "Invoice previews for 2026-03-21 22:00-23:30 UTC may be inaccurate due to tokenizer mismatch."
Priya: I'll open the revert PR and a follow-up PR that gates tokenizer upgrades across writer+ingest via a shared feature flag.
Julian: Also create a reconciliation script: re-run tokenization of preview texts with tally tokenizer (old) to compute what preview should have shown; that avoids customers seeing inconsistent previews.
Dan: For longer-term: schedule a controlled rollout of tokenize-plus across entire ingestion pipeline + a deterministic tokenizer test suite (set of edge-case texts including ZWJ, bidi, wide unicode, mixed languages).
Mei: Add a canary metric: population-weighted delta between preview_tokens and tally_tokens > 3% -> alarm + auto-pause preview-send for the tenant.
Arjun: InfraBot: please create incident and attach the affected tenant list and the revert PR link once it's up.
InfraBot: Incident created: #INC-2026-321 (title: tokenizer mismatch causing invoice-preview token delta). Assigned: Priya, Arjun, Dan.
Priya: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/preview-writer/pull/1423 (rolling back tokenizer). staging canary scheduled now.
Julian: I'll start the reconcile job spec (short job to recalc preview_tokens with old tokenizer and write corrected preview rows for the window). We should run on a sample first then full low-traffic window.
Dan: Also audit historical previews for last 7 days where tokenizer upgrade was partially rolled to any service; produce list of tenants with >2% sustained delta.
Mei: After revert, we need a postmortem: add a pre-flight check that any tokenizer lib bump must include a parity run between writer and ingest on a representative corpus and feature-flag enforcement.
Arjun: Quick win = revert + banner + reconcile. Medium = canary rollout of tokenize-plus across tallies + backfill. Long = tokenizer test harness and gating.
Priya: I'll patch the console banner and ensure invoice-preview email sends are suppressed for flagged windows.
Arjun: Thanks team. I'll update the incident with the reconciliation progress and the per-tenant reconciliation ETA.
